props.name: value
props.description:
The open state of the toggle group represented by an array of
the values of all pressed toggle buttons.
This is the controlled counterpart of `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The open state of the toggle group represented by an array of
the values of all pressed toggle buttons.
This is the uncontrolled counterpart of `value`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the pressed states of the toggle group changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the toggle group should ignore user interaction.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout axis used by the component.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item
when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: multiple
props.description:
When `false` only one item in the group can be pressed. If any item in
the group becomes pressed, the others will become unpressed.
When `true` multiple items can be pressed.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
